verdict.rationale: Copilot's docs show it can run multiple autonomous cloud agents in the background, with progress tracked across agents and sessions from one control page, so parallel agent work is supported. Nothing in the evidence shows fleet-scale concurrency or runs lasting hours or days. Missing for 10: evidence of long-running (hours/days) agent sessions, documented concurrency or fleet-scale limits, independent or hands-on corroboration of parallel multi-agent runs.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can launch fleets of autonomous agents that work in parallel on different tasks for hours or days

citations.quote: Assign tasks to agents like Copilot, Claude by Anthropic, and OpenAI Codex, and let them plan, explore, and execute work autonomously in the background.
Launch work from GitHub, track progress across multiple agents, review changes, and merge completed work—all from one desktop workspace built natively on GitHub.
Use one centralized control page to jump between agent sessions, check progress, and stay in control without losing your place.
With Copilot cloud agent, GitHub Copilot can work independently in the background to complete tasks, just like a human developer.
